result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, while expressly excluding the defined confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross-negligence, wilful-misconduct, fraud, and IP claims from the cap. Sections 21.2 and 21.3 retain the mutual consequential-damages exclusion and payment-obligation treatment. The revision is appropriately confined to Section 21.1 and preserves the remaining allocation of risk. Drafting is professional, although “total aggregate” is slightly redundant.
